notes: Previously seen historical development data, not independent or fresh blind validation.
Main and additional datasets are reported separately; no pooled headline score.
Hit@5 means at least one historical target in a sentence Top5; it is not suggestion precision.
Historical target lists need not exhaust every legally acceptable suggestion.
All declared offline agreement policies are explicitly post-hoc and all are reported.
Document agreement is context relevance, not proof that the focused sentence is supported.
Individual-target stage counts differ from case-level Hit@5 denominators.
Both factual questions reuse the same Qwen weights; the answers are not independent judges.
Granite quote grounding proves source presence, not legal correctness or calibration.
Granite errors exclude the affected case from both matched comparison arms and remain visible.
Shared run-local score caching makes observed variant wall times unsuitable as production latency.
No human suggestion-level gold labels or model training are manufactured by these experiments.
All 162 previously seen cases; this is not an independent quality dataset.
Actual fresh GPU outputs are retained even when they differ from exact CPU cache replay.
Synchronized per-case times exclude model load and one warmup per profile.
Logical pair savings are not converted into a claimed measured speedup.
